meta.title: Jigsaw — jigsaw puzzles without ads
meta.description: Jigsaw puzzles of 24, 54 and 96 pieces made from the rooms of the game Detective, and a puzzle of the day. No ads, no tracking, no accounts; works without the internet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ghostNote: It shows what goes where — that is easier. Without it the board is empty, as with real jigsaws.
settings.turningNote: The pieces lie turned in the tray. Tap a piece to take it; tap it again to turn it a quarter (the R key). A piece goes into its place only standing right.
settings.vibration: Vibration when a puzzle is done
settings.leftHand: Tray and buttons left of the board when the phone lies on its side
settings.installIos: On iPhone or iPad: tap “Share”, then “Add to Home Screen”.
settings.resetSure: Tap again to clear the puzzles begun, the days’ results and statistics

stats.title: Statistics
stats.note: No hints — put together without a single hint; fastest — the shortest time.

about.title: About the game
about.how: Drag a piece from the tray to its place on the board, or tap a piece and then its place. Near its own place a piece snaps in and stays; anywhere else it goes back to the tray. The tray starts with the corner and edge pieces. The pictures are rooms from the game Detective; the things in them lie somewhere else every time.
about.zoom: A big board can be zoomed in: the “Zoom in” button, two fingers, Ctrl with the mouse wheel, or the keys + and −; one finger or the wheel moves it.
about.text: No ads, no tracking, no accounts. Everything stays on this device; after the first visit the game works without the internet.
about.keys: Keys: in the tray, arrows go between pieces and Enter or Space takes one; then arrows go over the board’s places, Enter puts the piece and Esc gives it back; H — hint; + and − — zoom.
about.keysTurn: R — turn the piece (with “Turn the pieces” on).
